description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Karoo.
Repeat.
